commits.message:
A focused Dropdown's filter is the terminal's own cursor (rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr) (#566)

* A focused Dropdown's filter is the terminal's own cursor: where the painter shows it, the caret is a blank cell marked caretMark("bar"), its side set by ordering; labeled takes its label as segments so the mark survives ordering (rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr)

* Dropdown: the caret cell survives a header too narrow for its gutter; labeled keeps an empty frame-styled segment unoriented; docs no longer tie the filter's caret shape to TextInput's (review of rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr)

* Dropdown: a filter too long for the header shows its tail, so the caret stays at the editing point; docs name Live beside an app (review of rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr)

* Dropdown: the query's tail through cellFitEnd, its last glyph before the gutter; docs and module header say a long query shows its end (review of rich-control-codes-xh4n.okr)
